description: KNaS₂O₇ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. K is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.67-3.13 Å. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.59 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-52°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.44-1.64 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-58°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.43-1.65 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two S atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, two equivalent Na, and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three equivalent K and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one K, one Na, and one S atom.
